statements.chinese: 听着，关于如何告诉你这件事，我已经考虑了很久，而且……

statements.english: OK . The bottom line , Ross ..
statements.chinese: 好吧。重点是，Ross...

statements.english: ... is we cannot stay married
statements.chinese: ……是我们无法继续维持这段婚姻了。

statements.english: - l don't know if that's true– - Oh , but it is
statements.chinese: 我不知道这是不是真的——哦，但确实如此。

statements.english: Okay . You know what this is ?
statements.chinese: 好吧。你知道这是什么吗？

statements.english: This is a difference of opinion
statements.chinese: 这是意见上的分歧。

statements.english: When that happens in a marriage- -
statements.chinese: 当婚姻中出现这种情况时——

happens.definition: happen（第三人称单数）: 发生

statements.english: Ross , come on ! This is not ..
statements.chinese: Ross，别这样！这可不是...

statements.english: This is not a marriage !
statements.chinese: 这根本不是婚姻！

statements.english: This is the world's worst hangover !
statements.chinese: 这是世界上最糟糕的宿醉！

statements.english: Ross , listen , if you do not get this annulment , l will
statements.chinese: Ross，听着，如果你不去撤销这段婚姻，那就我来。

statements.english: All right . All right , l'll do it
statements.chinese: 好吧。好吧，我来做。

statements.english: Thank you
statements.chinese: 谢谢。

statements.english: Hey , hey . Uh ..
is there ... is there any such thing as an annulment shower ?
statements.chinese: 有没有...有没有所谓的废除婚礼派对？

statements.english: Oh , wait , wait ! There's the train station
statements.chinese: 哦，等等，等等！火车站就在那儿。

statements.english: This is where l get off
statements.chinese: 我就此告辞了。

get.definition: 短语动词原型: 下车

statements.english: Well , l have your address and phone number
statements.chinese: 好的，我有你的地址和电话号码。

statements.english: l have your name and the fact that you're a drifter
statements.chinese: 我知道你的名字，还有你是个漂泊者的事实。

statements.english: So ball's pretty much in your court
statements.chinese: 现在球基本在你那边了。

statements.english: All right . See you , Pheebs
statements.chinese: 好的，回见，Pheebs。

statements.english: Come on , Pheebs , l can't take this anymore
statements.chinese: 拜托了，Pheebs，我再也受不了了。

take.definition: 短语动词原型: 忍受

statements.english: Please talk to me
statements.chinese: 请和我聊聊。

statements.english: Let , let me make it up to you , uh ?
statements.chinese: 让我，让我补偿你吧，好吗？

statements.english: * Ground control to Major Tom *
statements.chinese: 地面控制中心呼叫Tom少校

statements.english: * Commencing countdown Engines on *
statements.chinese: 开始倒计时 引擎启动

statements.english: * Take your protein pills *
statements.chinese: 服用你的蛋白质药片

statements.english: * And put your helmet on *
statements.chinese: 还有戴上你的头盔

put.definition: put（短语动词原型）: 放置

statements.english: - This is- - - Stop it ! Stop it ! No !
statements.chinese: 这是---住手！住手！不行！

statements.english: That's not fair
statements.chinese: 这不公平。

statements.english: You know l can't resist that beautiful voice
statements.chinese: 你知道我无法抗拒那美妙的声音。

statements.english: Pheebs , look , l am so sorry
statements.chinese: Pheebs，听着，我真的很抱歉。

statements.english: I know l promised you a fun road trip with your friend ..
statements.chinese: 我记得答应过要带你和你朋友来场有趣的公路旅行……

statements.english: ... and l didn't deliver , okay ?
statements.chinese: ...而我搞砸了，行吗？

statements.english: But .. but now l know that you think
statements.chinese: 但...但现在我知道你是这么想的

statements.english: being awake is an important part of friendship
statements.chinese: 保持清醒是友谊的重要部分。

is.definition: be（第三人称单数现在时）: 是

statements.english: So l will strive to stay awake for as long as l know you
statements.chinese: 因此，只要我认识你，我就会努力保持清醒。

statements.english: You can still sleep at night and stuff
statements.chinese: 你晚上还是能睡个好觉什么的。

statements.english: Thank you
statements.chinese: 谢谢。

statements.english: So can we play 20 Questions now ?
statements.chinese: 那我们现在可以玩20个问题了吗？

statements.english: l got a good one
statements.chinese: 我有个不错的。
